title: When the Safehouse Burns
author: Quentin Crane
blurb: Paloma Winterbourne, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
